log.title: Delivery log
log.subject: Subject or title
log.failed: The delivery log could not be loaded.
templates.title: Templates
templates.language: Language code (empty for the default version)
templates.subject: Subject or title
templates.help: Write {name} where a value goes, and {section} around text shown only when name has a value. Optional messages can use {unsubscribeUrl}.
templates.required: Required message: always sent, even to people who unsubscribed (always for accounts. templates)
templates.urgent: Urgent: sent during quiet hours (always for accounts. templates)
templates.sensitive: Sensitive (codes, links): its values are hidden in the delivery log (always for accounts. templates)
templates.buttonsHelp: The buttons of the template at Meta that take a value, by their place in it (the first is 0). A copy-code button copies its value, for example {code}; a URL button adds its value to the end of its address.
templates.preview: Preview (type a sample for each value)
templates.testHelp: Send the saved template to yourself with the samples above.
templates.testTo: Send a test to (email address or phone number with country code)
templates.loadFailed: The templates could not be loaded: {reason}
send.title: Send a message
send.to: To (email address or phone number with country code)
send.subject: Subject
reason.unsubscribed: this person unsubscribed from optional messages, or from this message’s topic
reason.limited: this person already got as many messages as the send limits allow
reason.switched_off: this message is switched off on this channel in Notifications
reason.failed: every attempt failed (the delivery log shows each one)
reason.provider_refused: the provider answered that it did not take the message
reason.provider_unreachable: the provider could not be reached ({cause})
reason.connection_unusable: the {connection} connection does not fit its provider: check it in Connections
reason.no_subscription: no browser is subscribed for this recipient
reason.subscription_gone: the browser is no longer subscribed
reason.interrupted: it could not be sent then (a database or provider was briefly unreachable)
reason.sealed_unreadable: its hidden values cannot be read: the encryption key changed
reason.not_set_up: not set up: WhatsApp sends only templates approved at Meta. Add the WhatsApp template {template} with its Meta template name in Notifications
problem.offline: Notifications could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
problem.unauthorized: The sign-in has expired. Reload the page.
problem.invalid_token: The sign-in has expired. Reload the page.
problem.product_unavailable: Notifications is not available for this website right now.
problem.database_not_connected: The website's database is not connected yet.
problem.not_found: It was not found: it may have been deleted already.
problem.template_not_found: There is no saved template with this key for this channel.
problem.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
problem.validation_failed: Check the form, then try again.
problem.field.key: Use 1–64 lower-case letters, digits, _, . or - for the template key, starting with a letter.
problem.field.language: Use a language code such as en, fr or pt-BR, or leave the language empty.
problem.field.subject: Write the subject or title: one line of at most 200 characters.
problem.field.text: Write the message within the channel's length, and close every optional section.
problem.field.providerTemplate: Only WhatsApp templates have a template name at Meta: lower-case letters, digits and _.
problem.field.buttons: Check the buttons: each place from 0 to 9 once, with a type and a value.
problem.field.to: Enter an email address, or a phone number with its country code.
problem.field.values: Check the samples: at most 50, each at most 1000 characters.
unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.question: Stop optional messages from {business}?
unsubscribe.choose: Choose the messages {business} may send you:
unsubscribe.saved: Your choices are saved. You will still get the messages you need, such as sign-in codes and updates on what you asked for.
unsubscribe.done: You are unsubscribed. You will still get the messages you need, such as sign-in codes and updates on what you asked for.
unsubscribe.unavailable: This page is not available right now.
